name: econdash
description: 750+ indicators in ten categories: macroeconomics, financial markets, labor, demographics, real estate, commodities and energy, transport and logistics, healthcare, education, technology and internet. 290+ countries and regions, from the World Bank, IMF, FRED, Eurostat, OECD, WHO and other public sources. Every figure comes with its source, licence and a link to the EconDash chart.
